context: This combines the issue's diagnostics selector and output-path side-effect cases in an implementation task.

checklist.name: Creates requested command
checklist.description: Creates DiagnosticsCommand.java with select(...), finish(...), write, print, and the requested records.

checklist.name: Keeps boolean-only conflict check
checklist.description: Preserves the mutual-exclusion check and exact exception message without reading either value there.

checklist.name: Uses selector Optional boundaries
checklist.description: Uses board.map(...).orElseGet(...) with a nested workflow boundary, binds values once, or otherwise avoids presence-check/value-read selector branches.

checklist.name: Uses side-effect boundary
checklist.description: Uses output.ifPresentOrElse(...) or an equivalent Optional side-effect boundary for write vs print.

checklist.name: No fake collection or null workaround
checklist.description: Does not unwrap single Optionals via stream().toList(), lists, loops, or orElse(null) plus local null branching.

checklist.name: Preserves selection behavior
checklist.description: Returns board, workflow, and all selections with the required values and configDir.resolve(workflowValue).

checklist.name: Preserves output behavior
checklist.description: Calls write only when output is present and print only when absent.
